name: Scotch
description: Whisky distilled and aged in Scotland for at least three years in oak. Styles run from light, grain-led blends to rich sherried malts and smoky, peated island whiskies.

name: Blended Scotch
description: Scotch made by blending single malts with lighter grain whisky. Smooth, approachable and consistent, it is the usual choice for highballs, sours and classics like the Rob Roy and Penicillin.

name: Blended Malt Scotch
description: A blend of single malts from more than one Scottish distillery, with no grain whisky. Richer and maltier than a standard blend, and often made with mixing in mind.

name: Single Malt Scotch
description: Scotch made from malted barley in pot stills at a single distillery. Character depends on region and cask, from light and fruity Speyside malts to rich sherried or smoky styles.

name: Islay Scotch
description: Single malt from the island of Islay off the west coast of Scotland. Most are heavily peated, with smoke, brine and iodine notes, and are used in small measures, rinses and floats.

name: Peated Scotch
description: Scotch made from barley dried over peat smoke, giving a smoky, earthy and sometimes medicinal flavour. Most come from Islay and the islands, and a small amount goes a long way in a drink.

name: Irish Whiskey
description: Whiskey distilled and aged in Ireland for at least three years. Usually triple distilled and unpeated, it tends to be light, smooth and fruity, and includes blends, single malt and single pot still.

name: Japanese Whisky
description: Whisky made in Japan, modelled on Scotch methods. Typically precise and delicate, with soft fruit, light oak and sometimes gentle smoke. The standard base for a whisky highball.

name: Australian Whisky
description: Whisky distilled and aged in Australia, mostly single malt from Tasmania and Victoria. Often matured in local wine and fortified wine barrels, which give rich dried fruit and spice notes.

name: Indian Whisky
description: Whisky made in India. The single malts sold abroad are made from barley and mature quickly in the hot climate, giving bold tropical fruit, spice and oak flavours.

name: English Single Malt Whisky
description: Single malt whisky distilled and aged in England, a small but growing category. Usually unpeated, fruity and malty, and often aged in bourbon, wine or sherry casks.

name: Johnnie Walker Red Label
description: The entry-level Johnnie Walker blend, made for mixing. Lively and a little smoky with spice and fresh fruit, and one of the most widely sold Scotch whiskies in the world.

name: Johnnie Walker Black Label
match: Johnnie Walker Black Label Blended Scotch
description: A blended Scotch aged at least 12 years. Rounded and gently smoky with dried fruit, vanilla and toffee, it is a common call for a smoky highball or a Penicillin.

name: Johnnie Walker Double Black
description: A smokier take on Black Label with no age statement, using more peated west coast malts and heavily charred casks. Bold smoke with vanilla and dried fruit.

name: Johnnie Walker Green Label
description: A blended malt aged at least 15 years, built on Talisker, Caol Ila, Cragganmore and Linkwood. Grassy and fruity with wood smoke and pepper, and no grain whisky.

name: Johnnie Walker Gold Label Reserve
match: Johnnie Walker Gold Label Blended Scotch
Johnnie Walker Gold Reserve Blended Scotch

name: Johnnie Walker Blue Label
description: The top of the core Johnnie Walker range, blended from rare and aged casks with no age statement. Velvety, with honey, hazelnut, dried fruit, dark chocolate and soft smoke.

name: Dewar's White Label

name: Dewar's 12
description: A blended Scotch aged 12 years, then married in oak again after blending. Honeyed and fruity with toffee and a rounder, richer body than White Label. A bartender staple for stirred drinks.

name: The Famous Grouse

image_query: The Famous Grouse blended Scotch bottle

name: Teacher's Highland Cream

name: Kilchoman Machir Bay
